title: Indian Wedding Guest Outfits Under $60 for Every Function
excerpt: Affordable Indian wedding guest outfits under $60, from $19 haldi tops to $52 gota Anarkalis, with free shipping and tips to restyle.
body:
Yes, you can look beautiful at an Indian wedding for under $60, even outside India. Embroidered kurta sets, gota work Anarkalis and hand block printed sets direct from a Jaipur workshop all sit between $19 and $52, with free shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia. The trick is knowing which function deserves which piece, and how to make each one work twice.

## Why wedding outfits abroad cost so much

If you have shopped for Indian clothes in Toronto, London or New Jersey, you know the problem: a simple embroidered suit can cost far more than it would in India, and the fit is often a gamble. Multi-function weddings make it worse. Four events can mean four outfits.

Buying direct from the people who make the clothes keeps the price honest. Our pieces are made in our own unit in Jaipur, priced in USD, and paid through PayPal, so you know the full price upfront. Shipping is free and tracked. Import duties and taxes are included too – we ship duties-paid, so there is nothing extra to pay on delivery.

Here is how a full wedding wardrobe can break down:

| Function | Outfit | Price (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Haldi | Hand block print cotton tunic top with your own white pants | 19 |
| Mehndi | Embroidered kurti with side tie-up | 25 |
| Mehndi or day event | Hand block print kurta palazzo set | 36 |
| Puja or day wedding | Embroidered cotton kurta, pants and dupatta | 48 |
| Wedding ceremony | Embroidered kurta set with organza or kota doria dupatta | 52 |
| Sangeet or reception | Taffeta silk or georgette Anarkali with dupatta | 52 |

## The $19 to $25 tier: haldi and mehndi

Haldi and mehndi are casual, messy and fun. There is no reason to spend big on an outfit that might get turmeric or henna on it.

A short kurti over pants or palazzos you already own is perfect. The [Bottle Green Embroidered Kurti with Side Tie-Up](/products/green-embroidered-kurti/) costs $25 and green is the traditional mehndi colour. For the haldi, a hand block printed tunic top at $19 in yellow, coral or sky blue is cheerful and washes easily.

Our [tunic tops](/cotton-tunic-tops-short-kurtis-for-jeans/) collection has several colours to choose from.

## The $36 to $48 tier: day functions and pujas

For a family puja, a daytime ceremony or a smaller wedding, a full set looks more complete than a separates outfit.

The [Sage Teal Hand Block Print Cotton Kurta Palazzo Set](/products/sage-teal-block-print-cotton-kurta-palazzo-set/) at $36 is a relaxed, elegant option that also works for Diwali on 8 November.

At $48, the [Baby Pink Embroidered Cotton Kurta Pant Set with Bird Motif and Tassels](/products/baby-pink-bird-embroidered-cotton-kurta-pant-set/) feels special enough for a daytime wedding while staying breathable.

## The $52 tier: the main events

For the sangeet, wedding ceremony and reception, $52 gets you a full Anarkali or a dressy kurta set with dupatta. This is where gota work, taffeta silk and organza come in.

The [Lavender Taffeta Silk Gota Work Anarkali Suit Set with Organza Dupatta](/products/lavender-taffeta-silk-gota-work-anarkali-suit-set-with-organza-dupatta/) has the shine and structure of a much pricier outfit and looks lovely at an evening reception. If you prefer a straight cut, the embroidered kurta sets with cutwork organza dupattas in off-white or peach pink are equally dressy.

## Make one outfit work twice

The smartest way to save is to plan outfits that can be restyled:

- **Swap the dupatta.** A plain kurta set changes completely with a contrast or bandhani dupatta.
- **Change the jewellery.** Oxidised silver for the mehndi, gold-tone kundan for the reception.
- **Wear the kurta alone.** Many kurtas from sets look great with jeans after the wedding, so the outfit earns its place in your wardrobe.
- **Choose versatile colours.** Lavender, sage, peach and navy suit both day and night events.

With careful planning, two outfits at $52 and one at $25 can cover four functions for under $130 in total.

## Getting the fit right without spending more

Budget outfits often fail on fit, not fabric. We offer free custom fit: share your bust, waist, hip and height and we stitch to measure at no extra cost. Ready sizes ship in 2 to 4 working days, and made-to-measure pieces in 5 to 7 working days, with delivery taking about 5 to 10 business days. To be safe, order at least 3 to 4 weeks before the first function.

## Frequently asked questions

**Can I really find an Indian wedding outfit for under $60?**
Yes. Embroidered kurta sets and Anarkalis from $48 to $52 include the dupatta, and shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia is free.

**Will I pay customs duty?**
No. Import duties and taxes are included in the price – we ship duties-paid, so there is nothing to pay on delivery.

**Is a $25 kurti dressy enough for a wedding?**
For the mehndi or haldi, absolutely. For the wedding ceremony or reception, choose a full set or an Anarkali.

**Does custom stitching cost extra?**
No. Made-to-measure is free; it just takes a few extra working days.
